To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the agent Max is a multimodal assistant for construction tasks in virtual reality.

the multimodal behavior of Max can be generated in real-time, that the multimodal agent can be used to guide the human user through a cooperative task, and that the multimodal utterances of the agent are perceived as natural and appropriate by the users.

the integration of multimodal communication and situated interaction in a CAVE-like environment is feasible and that the resulting system provides a valuable testbed for further research on multimodal communication and interaction in virtual reality environments.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a virtual agent that is able to interact with a user in a multimodal, cooperative, and natural way in order to support the user in the performance of complex tasks in a virtual environment.
the development of a multimodal agent that is able to engage in cooperative assembly tasks with a human user in an immersive virtual environment.
the design of an interactive virtual environment that supports collaborative construction tasks by means of a synthetic agent.

Max has proven to be a useful assistant in cooperative construction tasks.
Max is a highly interactive agent that is able to perform multimodal communication with the user and to guide him through complex construction tasks in a virtual environment.
the development of Max has been successful in many respects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully implemented the basic functionality of Max.
Max is the first agent to be able to perform a complex assembly task with a user in a CAVE-like VR environment.
we have successfully developed an agent that is able to interactively engage in construction tasks with a human user in a virtual reality environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a virtual reality environment provides an ideal testbed for multimodal human-agent interaction research, because it allows for the development and evaluation of a complete system in a controlled setting.
a multimodal agent in virtual reality construction is feasible, and the agent can support the user by guiding him through complex construction tasks.
the design of multimodal conversational agents requires a careful integration of different modalities, which is achieved by the use of a multimodal planning component.
